visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a plated dish featuring fried eggs, scallions, and red chilies on a white plate atop a wooden surface. Then, hands appear, cracking two eggs into a black round electric pan containing oil. (2) A red lid with a black handle is placed over the pan, obscuring the eggs. (3) The lid is removed, revealing the eggs with set whites and soft yolks. Sliced ginger is placed in the center of the pan. (4) White shimeji mushrooms, a large handful of chopped green scallion stalks, and sliced red chilies are added over the eggs. The red lid is placed back on the pan. (5) The lid is lifted again, releasing a cloud of steam. Various liquid sauces—dark vinegar, oyster sauce, water, and soy sauce—are poured into the pan using a metal spoon from small clear bowls. (6) The mixture simmers and bubbles in the pan as the ingredients are gently shifted. The video concludes with a close-up of the final dish, garnished with fresh red chili, identical to the opening shot.
